document.title: Architecture Decision Index
purpose: Provide a single, machine-readable and human-readable outline of the architecture decisions captured in AR files.
Make cross-cutting code structure, style, and conformance principles explicit for implementation work.
Help implementation agents check proposed code changes against accepted architecture before editing.
source_of_truth: AR files remain the canonical record for individual architecture decisions.
ER and DR files remain the canonical records for implementation and defect closure.
This index is a derived guide and must be updated when AR decisions materially change.

implementation_engineer: Read this document before making code changes that touch public APIs, subsystem boundaries, persistence formats, error handling, or command behavior.
When this document conflicts with an accepted AR, follow the AR and update this document in the same change if the conflict is in scope.
When implementation behavior conflicts with this document, do not silently normalize the code. Record the mismatch as an ER, DR, or AR update as appropriate.
Do not mark ARs, ERs, or DRs Verified. Verification is reserved for the System Engineer.
change_control: New accepted ARs should add or update entries under architecture_decisions.
AR status changes to Implemented should be reflected here only after dependent ERs and DRs are verified or explicitly scoped out.
Cross-cutting principles should be changed by an AR, governance decision, or explicit System Engineer direction.

scope_control: Do not change behavior unrelated to the request.
Do not introduce new dependencies unless explicitly approved or unavoidable and justified.
When multiple valid architecture choices exist, ask the System Engineer instead of choosing silently.
code_structure: Subsystems should live behind explicit local module boundaries under src/.
Shared concepts should be represented through existing Referee, Refract, CEO, Conduit, Conch, Vizier, Services, Exec, Comms, Crate, Astra, Caliper, or Machine boundaries before adding a new boundary.
Large files should not grow through unrelated additions. Split new implementation into local modules when a subsystem is expanding.
Headers should expose stable contracts and keep implementation detail in source files unless a header-only template is clearly justified.
error_handling: Public subsystem APIs should return a project Result type rather than using exceptions for normal control flow.
Exceptions must not cross subsystem boundaries as the normal error mechanism.
NotFound semantics must be explicit and consistent at the API boundary.
The accepted AR-0001 target is typed expected-style errors with ErrorCode exposed through the project Result abstraction.
persistence: Persisted data must be deterministic across process restarts.
New persisted metadata requires explicit migration or compatibility behavior.
Referee and Refract are preferred sources of truth for object identity, schema, relationships, and reflection metadata.
Do not mutate generated Autotools artifacts unless explicitly instructed or required by a regeneration step that is called out.
testing: New behavior should be covered at the narrowest useful layer.
Changes to subsystem contracts, persistence, command behavior, or architecture closure require tests or an explicit reason tests were not run.
Defect fixes should include DR-linked regression coverage when practical.
user_interfaces: Conch command behavior should remain stable unless an ER or AR explicitly changes syntax or semantics.
Parser behavior should move toward typed AST and reusable command grammar surfaces without breaking existing command workflows unnecessarily.
Vizier and Conch view growth should preserve existing triggered artifact routing while staged observer-driven routing is introduced.

architecture_decisions.name: Expected-Style Error Model
architecture_decisions.decision: Use explicit result-style error propagation and avoid exceptions as normal cross-boundary control flow.
notes: The AR specifies Result<T> with expected-style semantics and enum class ErrorCode.
The current implementation provides enum class ErrorCode through referee::Result<T>.
ER-0081 through ER-0083 establish typed NotFound behavior across storage, Refract, and runtime lookups; ER-0086 completes the selected public-boundary error propagation audit.

architecture_decisions.name: Object Identity and Versioning Semantics
architecture_decisions.decision: Use stable UUID-style ObjectID values with versioning represented separately.

architecture_decisions.name: Storage Layout Strategy
architecture_decisions.decision: Use deterministic object storage with explicit layout/versioning; SQLite is accepted as the current realized backend while segment/index concepts remain architectural direction.

architecture_decisions.name: Index and Graph Storage Strategy
architecture_decisions.decision: Represent object and relationship indexes explicitly and support deterministic graph traversal and rebuild behavior.

architecture_decisions.name: Service Plane Model
architecture_decisions.decision: Model long-running services as stable service objects with lifecycle, discovery, messaging, and isolation.
notes: Later staged delivery is defined by AR-0022.
ER-0057 implements persistent discovery and CEO-backed hosts with explicit binding/start after recovery; the System Engineer confirmed Verified status and prior live verification on 2026-10-14.
Capability context, service boundary enforcement, and isolation hooks exist; expanded Stage E services remain follow-on work.

architecture_decisions.name: CEO/Exec Runtime Model
architecture_decisions.decision: Use CEO/Exec as the core task, waitable, message, and resource coordination substrate.
notes: The System Engineer confirmed the established runtime and ER-0057 Verified status on 2026-10-14; all listed ER dependencies are Verified.

architecture_decisions.name: Refract Reflection Graph
architecture_decisions.decision: Make Refract the persistent reflection graph for types, fields, operations, relationships, constraints, effects, and documentation.
notes: AR-0023 defines profile boundaries.
ER-0078, ER-0079, and ER-0080 are Verified and provide persisted constraints, effects, and documentation metadata.

architecture_decisions.name: Erector Subsystems
architecture_decisions.decision: Use Erector as the foundation for Math, Refract, Machine, Exec, and Comms object types.
notes: Exec, Comms primitives, Astra, and Caliper exist.
Machine primitives, descriptors, handles, and leases exist under AR-0024; ER-0070 through ER-0074 await System Engineer verification.

architecture_decisions.name: Referee Object Store
architecture_decisions.decision: Use Referee as the canonical object store and relationship graph manager.

architecture_decisions.name: Comms Subsystem
architecture_decisions.decision: Model communication through object-oriented link, transport, session, protocol, and addressing abstractions.
notes: Current implementation covers in-memory primitives, CEO I/O integration, and Machine-linked transport/session/protocol metadata.
AR-0024 mapping foundations and bounded loopback packet execution exist; physical drivers and full network stacks are outside that v1 scope.

architecture_decisions.name: Vizier Interpretation Layer
architecture_decisions.decision: Use Vizier to route object graph and artifact state into view models and Concho growth.
notes: Triggered artifact routing exists.
Graph routing and session growth are integrated into shell command boundaries; typed missing-artifact errors and operation metadata interpretation are implemented.

architecture_decisions.name: Conch Shell and Concho Views
architecture_decisions.decision: Use Conch as the terminal-first shell over object graph state and Conchos as object-backed views.
notes: Graph observation, relationship routing, and session growth have verified library support.
The running shell integrates session growth and the accepted nested tiling workspace data model.

architecture_decisions.name: Viz Display Subsystem
architecture_decisions.decision: Represent display artifacts as explicit objects such as panels, logs, metrics, tables, and trees.

architecture_decisions.name: Conch Schema and Object Authoring
architecture_decisions.decision: Allow Conch to define schemas and create object graph records through Refract and Referee.

architecture_decisions.name: Conch Parser and Syntax
architecture_decisions.decision: Move command parsing toward typed ASTs, parser-driven validation, and reusable grammar surfaces.
notes: ER-0067/68/69 and ER-0088/0091/0092 are Verified; all listed AR-0015 ER dependencies are Verified.
ER-0092's unknown-string escape behavior was delivered in PR #349, merged after CI run 38171360284 passed.

architecture_decisions.name: Operations and Dispatch Model
architecture_decisions.decision: Use Conduit and Refract metadata to resolve and dispatch operations across types.

architecture_decisions.name: Collections, Math Types, and Units
architecture_decisions.decision: Provide first-class collection, math, and unit type foundations.
notes: Collection, math, and starter unit ERs are Verified.
Batch contracts for collection operations, generic packs, numeric formats, type-level shapes, and value-level units are Verified through ER-0090/0093/0094/0096/0097/0098.
Implementation and validation completed in PR #346; the Caliper catalog follow-up is implemented under AR-0019.

architecture_decisions.name: Generic Type System
architecture_decisions.decision: Use explicit generic instance identity and scoped type registries for generic type behavior.

architecture_decisions.name: Caliper Unit Catalog
architecture_decisions.decision: Ship a complete, deterministic, versioned unit catalog with conversion metadata and extension rules.
notes: ER-0075/0076/0077/0089/0095/0099 are Verified after PR #347 merged and its required CI passed.
The immutable CALIPER-BASE-002 catalog preserves the historical CALIPER-BASE-001 identity and records.

architecture_decisions.name: Core Type Operations and Rendering
architecture_decisions.decision: Expose standard operations and rendering hooks for core types through Refract and Conduit.

architecture_decisions.name: Structured Types, Enums, and Packets
architecture_decisions.decision: Make structs, packets, enums, and structured arrays first-class Refract types.

architecture_decisions.name: Staged Service Plane Delivery
architecture_decisions.decision: Define Service Plane delivery stages A through E so implementation can close one maturity level at a time.
notes: ER-0057 implements service host lifecycle and persistent descriptor discovery; Verified status and prior live verification were confirmed by the System Engineer on 2026-10-14.
ER-0058 through ER-0061 are Verified for Stage D; ER-0062 provides a Verified metadata-only memory service baseline for Stage E.
Allocation, network services, and first-class sandbox/capability services remain follow-on Stage E scope.

architecture_decisions.name: Refract Reflection Profiles
architecture_decisions.decision: Separate Refract v1 core reflection from v2 extended reflection features.
notes: ER-0055, ER-0078, ER-0079, and ER-0080 are Verified and their implementation is present.
Batch ER-0103 repairs malformed persisted capability containers and tests capability metadata across reopen and inherited listing; its verification is tracked separately.
The source stores required_capabilities on operations; the System Engineer accepted this as the extended policy metadata scope on 2026-10-15; ER-0103 is Verified.

architecture_decisions.name: Erector Machine and Comms Delivery Tracks
architecture_decisions.decision: Stage Machine and Comms expansion into Machine core, descriptors, handles/leases, and Machine-backed Comms realization.
architecture_decisions.conformance: Implemented for all four scoped tracks
notes: All four delivery tracks have source and passing automated coverage under ER-0070 through ER-0074.
ER-0070 through ER-0074 are Verified after independent review, local tests, CI, and the System Engineer accepted automated evidence on 2026-10-15.

architecture_decisions.name: Conch and Vizier Interaction Modes
architecture_decisions.decision: Recognize triggered artifact routing as Mode 1 and define observer-driven graph routing as Mode 2.
notes: Mode 1 is implemented by verified ERs.
Cursor-driven observer growth and Task Conchos are implemented by verified ER-0063 through ER-0066; continuous event-driven notification remains planned.

architecture_decisions.name: Conch Parser Maturity Levels
architecture_decisions.decision: Define parser maturity levels from quote-aware command parsing through reusable command grammar surfaces.
notes: ER-0056 and ER-0088 implement typed command families and structured authoring handlers.
Reusable grammar, batch execution, and regression coverage are Verified under ER-0067 through ER-0069; ER-0091/0092 close grammar and escape coverage.

architecture_decisions.name: Standard Operation Contracts and Discovery
architecture_decisions.decision: Define a versioned catalog of operation contracts with explicit conformance, deterministic dispatch, effects, and Refract-based discovery.

known_conformance_gaps.gap: ER-0057 is Verified by System Engineer confirmation on 2026-10-14; expanded Stage E services remain planned. Capability context and isolation hooks are implemented.
Machine and Machine-linked Comms foundations are implemented but ER-0070 through ER-0074 await live pass and System Engineer verification.
Continuous event-driven graph notifications remain planned; cursor-driven session growth and Task Conchos are implemented by verified ER-0063 through ER-0066.
Constraints, operation effects, and documentation metadata are implemented under Verified ERs; the extended policy metadata scope awaits System Engineer clarification.
